f6Mechanism: Verified: cache-only ensureRange prefetch avoids discarded output copies; demand reads retain independent ownership. Broader scheduling and runtime headroom obligations remain open under M2/V1.

contracts: No discarded prefetch copies for private/shared caches; independent mutable demand outputs.
Coalesced pending prefetch/demand deduplication, including cross-wrapper and cross-job reads.
File identity/version separation and failed pending-entry retry.
Admission before transport/output overlap, cache eviction with live pins and optional prefetch decline.
One waiter cancellation preserves others; last waiter aborts; in-flight reads settle before failure.
Bounded read concurrency and exact-demand fallback when coalesced windows cannot fit.

liveR2.coalescedReadCase: Four data requests / 4096 bytes, plus one 2-byte metadata probe; concurrency 1/2/4 honored.

limitations: Copy benchmark uses a discarded-demand control after identical coalescing, not a full historical revision. Timings use simulated local transport delay.
Copied-byte volume is not heap/GC residency.
Live endpoint run uses HTTP from Node, not native deployed Worker bindings; single-run latency is not a statistical throughput claim.
128 KiB headroom was not rerun; its earlier typed failure remains historical evidence.
All F1-F6/M1-M2/V1-V3 requirements must still be audited before overall completion.
